name: Sending Stones

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Sending
powers.text: Once per dawn, cast Sending to the bearer of the other stone.

summary: A pair of stones: once a day, send a short message to whoever holds the other.
text: These stones are made in matched pairs, each carved so its partner is easy to identify. Touching one, you can use it to cast Sending, and the message always goes to whoever holds the other stone. If nobody holds the other stone, you learn this the moment you try, and no spell is cast. After the pair has been used to cast Sending, neither stone works again until the next dawn. Destroying one stone makes its partner nonmagical.
